rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something recently begun that has not fully taken shape yet.

example.english: This plan has just started and is still inchoate.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃啱啱開始，仲未成形。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hoi1 ci2 zung6 mei6 sing4 jing4

rows.note: Use this for something generally chaotic, disordered, or confused rather than merely unfinished.

example.english: After we moved, the whole flat was chaotic and inchoate.
example.traditional: 搬完屋之後，成間屋亂七八糟。
example.jyutping: bun1 jyun4 uk1 zi1 hau6 sing4 gaan1 uk1 lyun6 cat1 baat3 zou1

rows.note: Use this specifically for speech or writing that is incoherent, rambling, or poorly organized.

example.english: When he gets nervous, his speech becomes inchoate.
example.traditional: 佢一緊張就講到語無倫次。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 gan2 zoeng1 zau6 gong2 dou3 jyu5 mou4 leon4 ci3
